title: Can ChatGPT be a good follower of academic paradigms? Research quality evaluations in conflicting areas of sociology
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures whether ChatGPT can be prompted to show partiality for or against specific academic paradigms in sociology.
findings: This paper does not analyze aspects of religion; therefore, there are no findings related to religion.
